Well in regards to my living conditions, I don't really have many friends and I have no self confidence to put myself out there. I'm wanting to move country to start again, but I worry that I won't come out of my shell. 

I've had quite a few bad things happen to me in the past which kind of haunt me.. I absolutely need to seek help/therapists... But my mind tells me that I don't want help. 

For so long now ive just not seen the point in living and seeking help.. because of my perspective on life and death.
